episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Defying his master, Lee Yoon heads to North Gando to search for a man from his past — but danger from all sides proves to test his strength and vigilance.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Nam Hee Shin leaves for the railroad ceremony to take part in a secret plan, but she faces several obstacles as hiccups occur and rivals take notice.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Lee Kwang Il brutally attempts to extract information from an independence fighter. As Yoon approaches Hee Shin, Eon Nyun Yi provokes him.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As news of the railroad funds make the rounds, Yoon and his bandits come up against the Mounted Bandits. Hee Shin plans tricks of her own.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Yoon tracks down the railroad funds and encounters a frenzy. He later accompanies Hee Shin to complete her mission but comes upon another complication.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Choi Choong Soo questions Yoon's motives — realizing the truth may hurt their relationship. Eon Nyun Yi gives Choong Soo a stern warning.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Eon Nyuni hesitates in her mission, getting caught in the process. As forces come together to fight against Kwang Il, Hee Shin and Yoon part ways.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Yoon comes face to face with Kwang Il for a tense duel. Choong Soo and his bandits fight Jang Ki Ryong and his men — all for the safety of their town.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Choong Soo and his bandits face off against the town authorities. Kwang Il, Hee Shin and Yoon all discover the Japanese Army's true plans with Gando.
